title: Bird Monitor
_comment: Edit this file to set your spots and species checklists. 'n' = display name (required), 's' = scientific name (optional). Plain strings also work. taxa = the default 'Quick' list shown at session start (kept short and practical); taxaFull = an optional comprehensive alternative per taxon, selectable at session start (currently only provided for Birds). Birds lists sourced from Nature Safari India's Kaziranga National Park checklist (naturesafariindia.com). Mammals/Herps sourced from Wikipedia's 'Fauna of Kaziranga National Park' and 'List of reptiles of Kaziranga National Park'. Insects is a starter list of common regional butterflies (no single authoritative checklist was available) meant to grow via the in-app 'add species' feature.
